title: fix: deserialize null as None in visitor results
author: Juice-de-Orange
summary: Fixes the 1.30.2 visitor regression (#1065, #1081, ~29 reactions combined): after the switch to serde-content (#1062), a JS `null` deserializes as Value::Unit and fails on Option fields, so any visitor returning a node containing `var()` throws. The PR converts Unit to Option(None) recursively before deserializing in the Property, CssRule and napi ValueOrVec deserializers.
evidence: repro.mjs: `StyleSheetExit(s){return s}` on `.foo{color:var(--color)}` -> 1.33.0: `ERROR: failed to deserialize; expected an object-like struct named Specifier, found ()`; 1.30.1: correct. Master has no null handling in src/serialization.rs (unchanged). Maintainer previously agreed #1065 is a high-priority regression (calibration log). Review points: the recursive null_to_none walks every buffered value (perf on large StyleSheetExit returns; it moves values, no clone), and the helper is duplicated in napi/src/transformer.rs; check whether a Unit could ever be legitimately expected (e.g. unit variants) and that it is applied at all deserialization entry points.
